# Project Guidelines

- This is a static, white-label jewellery storefront generated by a zero-framework Node build (`npm run build` → `dist/`).
- Shop content lives in `/store` (JSON + HTML). Prefer changing data there over editing templates.
- Engine: `src/build.mjs`, templates in `src/templates/*.mjs`, browser code in `src/static/` (`store.css`, `store.js`, `studio-page.js`).
- The 3D Design Studio is `assets/js/designer.js` (+ `ar-tryon.js`); its markup is `src/studio/studio-markup.html`. Its CSS is generated at build time from `assets/css/*` by `src/lib/legacy-css.mjs`.
- `legacy-v1/` holds the previous hand-written pages; it is not published.
- Keep dependencies minimal (only optional `sharp` for image optimization). Update README.md when adding setup steps.
- Prefer accessibility and semantic HTML (labels, alt text, heading order, focus management).
